justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Course content evidence-based; certification-specific outcome comparison absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Duke CERT-MMOA online course; relatively low cost and time; accessible self-directed format.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any clinician working with older adults; evidence-based geriatric exercise focus broadly useful.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No billing premium; course adds clinical knowledge but does not impact payer reimbursement.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing recognition in geriatric PT programs; not yet widely listed in job postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Older adults value geriatric-focused care approach.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Cash-pay older-adult wellness/fall-prevention is a growing but still modest segment.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Limited pricing power; competes with Medicare-funded services.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: APTA Geriatrics cert series is professionally credible but invisible to consumers.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Geriatric wellness programs can be staffed and scaled with trained clinicians.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Older adults generally use insurance; cash demand exists in performance/longevity niches only.
justifications.business.efficiency: Online format, reasonable cost, completable in months — efficient relative to outcomes.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Respected APTA-affiliated cert series; useful but lower-tier than GCS for academia.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Curriculum is evidence-based but doesn't itself produce scholarship.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent prep for teaching geriatrics modules in DPT curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Built explicitly on current geriatric PT evidence (e.g., high-intensity resistance training, dosing).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally noted in geriatrics-focused faculty postings but not commonly required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Efficient, low-cost upskill for faculty teaching older-adult content.
